name: Applications row view exposes the complete portfolio column set
description:
Objective: Applications row view exposes the complete portfolio column set.
Preconditions: Open Applications with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Applications.
2. Applications row view exposes the complete portfolio column set.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: The row view must retain every business column used by operations.
